query: ok so we need multi-currency support in the billing service — prices in usd/eur/brl, stored in cents, and the invoice pdf has to render the right symbol. can you dig through the repo, ask me whatever you need, then actually build it and get the tests passing? dont just hand me a plan

i've got docs/prd/team-workspaces.md written up already. take it from there and drive the whole implementation — plan, code, review, tests. i'll approve the plan but otherwise dont make me babysit each step
add SSO via okta to the admin portal. this touches the express api, the next.js frontend and the react native app so it spans a few surfaces — use parallel agents where it makes sense
we need to let users export their transaction history as csv. background job if its slow, sync if its not — figure out which. build it end to end please, incl tests
can you set up which model runs each phase of the build? i want opus doing code review and haiku running the test suite, sonnet for everything else
the checkout flow needs idempotency keys so double-clicks stop creating duplicate orders. investigate how our stripe webhook handler works today, plan it out, then ship the change with tests
take the plan in docs/plans/notification-prefs.md and just execute it, its already approved. i dont need another planning round

we're adding a 'pause subscription' feature - user picks 1/2/3 months, billing skips, access continues. i want the whole thing: db migration, api, the settings ui, and tests. grill me on the edge cases first though

rewrite the search to use postgres full text search instead of the current LIKE queries. im not sure pg fts is actually fast enough at our scale (~2M rows in listings) so validate that before we commit to the approach, then build it
replace our homegrown feature flag helper in lib/flags.ts with launchdarkly across the whole app. i want this actually done and green, not a migration guide
/implement --no-e2e add rate limiting to the public api — the e2e suite takes forever in this repo, unit and integration coverage is enough for this one
/implement --no-e2e --no-spikes wire the new webhook retry queue into the billing service. skip the exploratory spikes and the e2e layer, i know the stack cold
start a time-boxed spike to figure out whether we can do offline caption caching on ios. 3 days max, i just need the question answered, not a shipped feature
can you review the diff on my branch before i open the PR? mainly worried about tenant isolation in the new report queries
turn docs/prd/team-workspaces.md into engineering tickets — one per layer, with acceptance criteria and QA steps
write me a PRD for a referral program. existing users get a month free when someone they invite subscribes
fix the typo in the error message in src/auth/login.ts — it says 'Ivalid credentials'
walk me through how the retry logic in queue/worker.ts works, i inherited this service and dont get the backoff math
i've got a merge conflict in package-lock.json after rebasing onto main, can you sort it out
prototype a throwaway script that hits the openai batch api and tells me roughly what itd cost per month at 50k docs. i just want the number, nothing shipped
we need to decide between temporal and inngest for our workflow engine. write up a comparison with pros/cons for our use case and give me a recommendation
our checkout page takes 4s to load in prod but its fine locally. can you figure out whats going on?
